end.summary:
Practised plotting ordered pairs (x, y) and identifying quadrants from coordinate signs.
Initially placed (3, 2) and (2, 3) at the same location; later explained why they are different points.
Identified that points with two positive coordinates lie in Quadrant I.
Identified (−, +) as Quadrant II; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Harsh practised moving right/left by the x-coordinate and up/down by the y-coordinate. They corrected the mix-up about (3, 2) and (2, 3) by explaining the two movements clearly, and correctly connected positive signs with Quadrant I and (−, +) with Quadrant II. At home, ask them to plot two ordered pairs with the numbers reversed and say the quadrant for each.
